paraphrase: Whatever is in potency in no respect has a life that neither begins nor ends in the duration frame. Encodes ST I q.10 a.1 ('omnino immutabile ... nec principium nec finem habere potest') reading 'altogether immutable' as 'in potency in no respect' (potency in the subject); that reading is stronger than the source, whose 'omnino immutabile' also excludes q.9 a.2's mutability through a power in another.
